top_signals.title: US Stocks Slip Before PPI Data, Oracle Earnings: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stock futures fell and Treasury yields pushed higher as risk appetite remained firmly in check ahead of the latest print on US factory prices and key tech earnings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: US Air Force seeks ‘rapidly deployable’ drone swarms for base security
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Air Force is looking to use "rapidly deployable" swarms of AI-controlled drones for base security.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Wall Street Is Betting On a Split Congress With Midterms on Tap
top_signals.summary: The midterm election season has entered its final stretch, and Wall Street is busy drawing up game plans for a range of scenarios. Yet, in a fortuitous turn of events, the best outcome for markets is also looking like the likeliest one.

top_signals.title: Hospitality sector blasts Burnham’s uncapped tourist tax
top_signals.summary: The hospitality sector has blasted proposals from Andy Burnham’s government to introduce a fresh tax on tourists. The industry has been left reeling after the government confirmed a new overnight levy on tourists that will have no upper cap.
